## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2022-01-27: Trebia Acquisition Corp. consummated the Business Combination with S1 Holdco, LLC; renamed System1, Inc. and executed the TRA
- 2022-01-28: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the closing 8-K

#### First material liability recognition

- 2024-08-01: Internal Up-C reorganization interposed System1 Holdings, LLC between System1, Inc. and S1 Holdco; the TRA was not amended
- 2024-12-31: TRA liability stepped from $0.9M to $5.3M after 2.8M Class B Unit redemptions during 2024; management first concluded TRA payment was probable

## Explanation

System1, Inc. executed this TRA on January 27, 2022 at the closing of its de-SPAC Up-C business combination (Trebia Acquisition Corp. merging with S1 Holdco, LLC), agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future redemptions of S1 Holdco Class B Units. The TRA Holders are the founder vehicles (Total Security Limited / Lone Investment Holdings) and Cannae Holdings, represented by co-founder Michael Blend. The recognized liability was near zero through 2023 because System1 operated with a full valuation allowance against its U.S. deferred tax assets; in 2024 a wave of 2.8M Class B Unit redemptions stepped the recognized liability to $5.3M as management concluded payment was probable for the first time. An August 2024 internal reorganization interposed System1 Holdings, LLC between System1, Inc. and S1 Holdco but did not amend the TRA itself. No amendment, restatement, or termination instrument has been filed; the TRA remains in force as of Q1 2026. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
